title: ruin-theory: Numerical and simulation tools for ruin theory in Python
description: A Python package for classical and renewal ruin theory, finite-time ruin recursions, prevention, red-time diagnostics, multirisk models, heavy-tail asymptotics, and reproducible numerical validation.
